name: Subfab pump and abatement kit
description: Pad with yellow hazard edges, four dry pumps in two pairs with green run lamps, abatement cabinet with control panel at the -X end and a spinning fan on top, four stainless forelines and a galvanised exhaust duct to Y 6.0, PVC drain lines and a cable tray at Y 3.0. 9 palette materials, 2,464 triangles.
brief: Foundry Floor interior batch 3, asset 1: subfab dry-pump and point-of-use abatement kit, 3.6 x 6.0 x 2.4 m (X x Y x Z). Root pivot at the pad centre on the subfab floor (Y 0), +X is the service side (pump fronts). Forelines and exhaust duct rise to exactly Y 6.0; locator toolAbove (0, 6, 0); clip FanSpin 1 s (abatementFan 360 degrees, constant speed).
